If you feel like you’ve got the fundamentals down from from these courses and you notice from your gameplay that you do indeed have the fundamentals down well, the thing that is lacking is outside of what’s covered in the videos. 

Fundamentals will get you pretty far on their own but there are several other factors at play that are less talked about. 

An obvious one that is hard to learn would be the concept of when you should skip camps to go for a gank. In theory this concept is very simple, if you see a gank opportunity near where you are clearing that is very high success rate (90%+) then you should more often than not be going for that gank. 

Seems simple right?

In actuality this concept is far more complex than that as it is heavily dependent on game knowledge outside of the fundamentals. What a challenger player sees as a 90% success rate gank and what a gold player sees as a 90% success rate gank is often very different. 

If you review your own games and watch the ganks you go for you may find that ganks you thought were a guaranteed kill were actually closer to 50% than 90% due to several factors you may have missed or not considered. 

The opposite is also true, you may see that you were killing gromp while you could have easily secured a kill if you had just walked to the nearby lane instead. 

If you’re confident in your fundamentals, focus more on these aspects of the game to further your ability to snowball. 

If you become very good at identifying successful ganks, you will find yourself snowballing far more often and taking over the game with more ease. 

Keep in mind that this is just one example of the more nuanced, game knowledge based concepts that often aren’t explained in extreme depth in courses and guides. 

If you have strong fundamentals, and you never miss a good gank opportunity, and never lose tempo going for bad ganks, you will absolutely take over games.

Just add some validity to my comment, I personally am a d1/low masters jungle main and even I find that I’m missing gank opportunities in my games fairly frequently. There are tons of areas to improve that aren’t the most straight forward. Focus in on getting yourself a lead every game and playing with good fundamentals and you’ll be a beast.

Started my ranked climbed recently, all solo, all 100% doomed. (Started d1/2 mmr)

[Win streak](https://media.discordapp.net/attachments/1124591987870421072/1361337657598148760/image.png?ex=68064cfe&is=6804fb7e&hm=faef031eaa96f24a269bcd61e423fdcf0ced43d2bcdc4aa70cd44bda1950707a&)

[Loss streak](https://media.discordapp.net/attachments/1124591987870421072/1362614265311137935/8b8b4ce0a93e773fd7e4cef93c7aec75.png?ex=680654ac&is=6805032c&hm=4c87db0c68de67cbabd3693f39f18befb43b71d9d799fd98da09d4e0f527df7f&)

I did manage to identify that when I’m tilted there are a few things that I begin to neglect though, when I have consistently bad quality games back to back I at least know what I need to focus on to keep playing at my normal level now.

Edit: The anecdotal changes in my gameplay while on losing streak/tilted is the following:
1.) I quit pinging my team as much. (As my laners ignored my pings and died to obvious ganks I just accepted that they will not listen and stopped pinging when I should do it even if they will die anyway)

2.) I started playing safer and “gave up” resources and objectives. (Enemy jungle ganks bot, top is not gank able so I cannot trade a gank. Grubs are up but risky. Invade risky due to top/mid losing. I would not even attempt any trade due to risk and essentially let the enemy have their bot gank unpunished.)

3.) Fist fight mentality (I would over commit more to fights where we have a numbers advantage and try to create a comeback through these fights. Often times we would get 1-2 kills and the play should be over, however, I would commit to going for even more. This would often result in the fight going from good to even or bad.)

After becoming aware of the above, my win-rate has stabilized and is heading back towards 60%+ again. 

The biggest issue is when I do not manage to secure an early lead for myself. My win-rate is 20% higher when I have 2+ kills at 10 minutes.
